candidates.description: This vector activates strongly for words and subwords containing the Thai consonant letter kho kai (ก) alongside various vowel marks and tone diacritics.
This vector activates on occurrences of the Thai consonant letter "ท" (tho thahan) in various contextual substrings.
This feature vector represents a noisy collection of subword tokens from multiple distinct languages and scripts.
This feature vector represents common morphological suffixes and phonetic fragments from various world languages.
The tokens represent Thai script characters, subwords, and common linguistic fragments, often appearing as artifacts of Thai text tokenization.
This feature vector activates strongly on prominent capital letters, alphanumeric abbreviations, and specific non-Latin script characters.
This vector represents directional movement and locational transition words in various languages, particularly Thai verbs of motion.
This vector activates on multilingual subword tokens, foreign script characters, and fragmented strings across diverse languages.
This feature vector represents subword tokens and functional morphemes predominantly found in the Thai language.
This feature vector activates strongly on specific consonant-vowel combinations and linguistic fragments found in Thai script and romanized text.
